## Product Description

This free browser-based tool helps restaurants, cafes, and bars turn existing menu images into QR codes. Users can optionally add a logo and customize QR colors. No account or subscription is required.

## Supported Files and Workflow

1. Select a JPG, PNG, or WEBP menu image up to 10 MB.
2. The browser resizes and re-encodes the selected image as WEBP.
3. To create a shareable QR code, the processed image is uploaded to Cloudflare R2 and the QR code encodes its public URL.
4. Logo overlays and QR styling are rendered in the browser.
5. Customers scan the QR code to open the hosted menu image.

## Important Limitations and Data Handling

- This is an image-to-QR tool, not an interactive text menu editor. To change menu text or prices, update the source image and generate a new QR code.
- The QR code has no built-in expiration timer, but access to a cloud-hosted menu depends on the public image URL remaining available.
- Uploaded menu images are stored in Cloudflare R2 to provide a shareable public URL. Do not upload files that should remain private.
- The page loads Google Analytics after user interaction or after a short delay.
- The browser accepts source images up to 10 MB, then re-encodes them as WEBP. The processed WEBP file must be no larger than 4 MB to upload to R2.
